sections.heading: The Shape That Says It Before You Open It
sections.text: Die-Formed Heart Rigid Box The Shape That Says It Before You Open It A heart-shaped box carries emotional meaning the moment it is seen — which is why it is the default choice for proposals, Valentine, weddings and romantic jewelry gifting. The challenge is making the curved silhouette clean and structural, not flimsy; that is what our die-forming and hand-wrapping process delivers. Each heart box is built on a rigid board frame wrapped in soft-touch, velvet-texture or art paper, with crisp seams around the curves and a flush lid line. Choose a flip-top hinge or a lift-off clamshell, finished with a satin ribbon pull, gold foil monogram or blind emboss. Inside, a custom velvet insert holds rings, pendants or a chocolate tray securely, so the gift presents perfectly on opening. Available in any brand colour — blush, red, black, ivory — with matching ribbon.

Valentine & Romance Brand-colour heart boxes for Valentine campaigns, anniversaries and proposals. Weddings & Favors Mini heart favor boxes and keepsake boxes for wedding guests and bridal parties. Chocolate & Confectionery Food-safe heart boxes with truffle trays for premium chocolate and praline brands.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.text: Questions Frequently Asked Questions How are heart-shaped rigid boxes made? We die-form a rigid board frame into a clean heart silhouette and hand-wrap it with your chosen paper — not a hollow blow-moulded shell. This gives sharp curves, a flush lid line and a premium, structural feel. What insert options are available for jewelry? Custom velvet inserts with a ring slot, necklace bar, earring pad or multi-piece layout, plus food-safe trays for chocolate. All cut to your exact product. What is the MOQ for custom heart boxes? Standard MOQ is 100 pcs for a custom size, brand colour and insert — accessible for boutique jewelry and Valentine launches. Can the box be made in our exact brand colour? Yes. We match Pantone PMS colours for the wrap and ribbon, in blush, red, black, ivory or any custom shade. Can heart boxes be food-safe for chocolate? Yes. We provide food-safe insert trays and liners suitable for truffles, pralines and confectionery.
